subject: EvaNet status: ensemble reproduced, flow cost is the trade-off
body:
Hi Lucia, Deshawn,

Status.

Reproduction: done May 20. Running the released four-checkpoint ensemble (rgb1, rgb2, flow1, flow2) through our mirrored assets gives 77.1% on Kinetics-400 validation - within noise of the published 77.2%, checksums clean. The HMDB cricket sample runs end to end through Giannis's serving path as a smoke test.

Partner eval: Rafael's flow pipeline is processing the archive now - throughput is at plan after he moved flow computation to batched GPU kernels (was 4x too slow on CPU).

The trade-off to line up for the pre-read: flow computation is ~70% of total inference cost. RGB-only (rgb1+rgb2) scores 74.3% on our partner validation slice vs 76.8% for the full ensemble. So the question for launch is whether 2.5 points buys a 3x cost multiplier. My lean: ship both modes, default RGB-only, flow as a "high-accuracy" tier.

Full partner-data numbers by Jun 24, two days ahead of gate.

Yusuf
